title: Helper Hub
description: Scene transitions (TV static, smoke, spinner, cinematic whip, and a custom animation), images and YouTube in chat and playlists, a Discord text-channel mirror, journal map pins, role-colored token frames, animated status effects, generated NPC token names, GM hit-point and status controls in combat, a display-screen account mode for a TV or monitor, and shared images and journals shown centered with close-for-everyone.
